distributionTitle: ONE LINK. MANY WAYS TO RECEIVE BOOKINGS.
distributionBody: Your public profile and enquiry form, where people already find you. Promoters can send a request without creating an account.
channels: Link your profile in your bio or share it in direct messages.
Configure the link in greeting, away or prepared messages.
Embed the booking widget or link directly to the form.
Put your profile on posters, EPKs and other physical or digital materials.
Share it by email, message or any other channel.
manual: Instagram and WhatsApp are not automatically connected. You configure and share the link on each platform.
linkExample: Example link structure; this is not a published profile.
journeyBody: One opportunity keeps its conversation, terms and next action together. A hold is not a confirmation.
stepBodies: The promoter submits details from your public profile.
Review the contact, date and proposal before proceeding.
Record messages and agreements in the same booking.
Mark provisional availability and its expiry.
Confirm the terms once the decision is agreed.
Check dates and distinguish holds from confirmations.
emailTitle: AN OFFER ARRIVES. CUEBOOKER PUTS IT IN ORDER.
emailBody: With an approved mailbox and detection enabled, Cuebooker identifies possible proposals and prepares an enquiry from the available information. You review and decide.
emailStages: Distinguishes possible booking offers from unrelated messages.
Captures contact, artist, date, venue and terms when mentioned.
Prepares a request using available information so you can check it and decide the next step.
emailNote: Mailbox connection is a private beta, subject to approval and limited places. PDF, PNG and JPG are supported within the workspace limits; other formats may not be imported. The public form does not require connecting your mailbox.
ecosystem: Your professional introduction and entry point for requests.
Basic CUE Passport is already built from confirmed bookings: cities, venues and dates. You decide whether its summary appears on your public profile. Advanced and media options depend on your plan.
Your own visual identity within the Cuebooker universe.
rosterBody: Review opportunities across your artists. Select one to focus on their enquiries, conversations and dates.
contextBody: Open a proposal to see the artist, contact, conversation and next action together. If an enquiry comes to the agency, decide which artist fits while keeping the conversation in view.
context: Review the proposal and reply to the contact

passport.title: CONFIRMED DATES BUILD YOUR TRAJECTORY.
passport.body: Confirmed bookings build your trajectory: cities, venues and dates in the basic Passport constellation and timeline. You control whether its summary appears on your public profile. Linked media requires a compatible plan.

catalog.title: YOUR ROSTER CAN HAVE A PUBLIC ENTRY POINT TOO.
catalog.body: The public catalogue is in beta. When you publish it from Settings, you choose visible artists and promoters can enquire without registering. Only the roster you choose to publish is shown.

cueId.title: YOUR IDENTITY. YOUR WAY.
cueId.body: We’re creating a space where you’ll be able to design your own avatar and give your artistic project a unique visual identity. In the future, the idea is that you can display it on your Cuebooker profile and share it on your social media, if you’d like.
